description: This Java source file defines an Android live wallpaper service that draws a rotating wireframe cube. It includes a main service class 'CubeWallpaper1' extending WallpaperService, and an inner engine class 'CubeEngine' handling the drawing and user interactions for the wallpaper.

classes.name: CubeWallpaper1
classes.description: Main service class extending WallpaperService that creates and manages the wallpaper engine.

classes.name: CubeEngine
classes.description: Inner class extending WallpaperService.Engine responsible for drawing the animated wireframe cube, handling touch events, and managing the rendering loop.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources when service is destroyed.

methods.name: onCreateEngine
methods.description: Creates an instance of the cube engine which handles the drawing.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runnable that triggers the drawing of a new frame.

methods.name: play drawFrame
methods.description: Handles drawing a frame, including the cube and touch point, and scheduling the next frame.

methods.name: drawCube
methods.description: Draws a wireframe cube by rendering lines between corner points.

methods.name: drawLine
methods.description: Draws a 3D line projected onto 2D, applying rotation transformations for animation.

methods.name: drawTouchPoint
methods.description: Draws a circle at the current touch point, if any.

methods.name: onSurfaceChanged
methods.description: Updates the center coordinates when the surface size changes.

methods.name: onSurfaceCreated
methods.description: Handles actions when the surface is created.

methods.name: onSurfaceDestroyed
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the surface is destroyed.

methods.name: onOffsetsChanged
methods.description: Handles offset changes, typically for parallax effects.

methods.name: onTouchEvent
methods.description: Captures touch events to modify the animation based on user interaction.
